rounds.name: Around the World in 30 Seconds
rounds.author: Ion Hardie (Reflexive)
notes: This level works by having 4 montior bricks that control each of 4 groups
The monitors do: wait for other monitor to advance me, if I'm not the only one left, tell my bricks to go out, and if I have any bricks, wait 5 seconds for them
The groups wait for them to be last or wait for the monitor to trigger them, then they go out, wait, go in
One plug-in is a hack to make advance next seq skip the top level rather than root sequence
it is: (Seq (sim (seq (empty)) (seq (wait for bricks)))) - it works because the advance stops the empty seq which stops the simul which advances the root seq
